## Checklist

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion has a test named after its story
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passed on commit: <!-- sha -->
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Internal specification updated, if a story or contract changed (maintainer)
- [ ] People see a change? Its user-guide page under `apps/docs/src/content/docs/guide/` is added or updated, using the app's exact words (US-SITE-05)
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
